chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Putting wealth in proper order is part of faith."

key_terms.إِصْلَاحُ: setting right, rectifying, or properly managing
key_terms.اَلْإِيمَانِ: faith, here meaning a quality of true belief

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام relate managing wealth to faith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that proper care, management, and sound ordering of one's wealth is not separate from religion, but belongs to iman. The hadith presents financial responsibility as a moral and faith-based duty.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3617 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Managing wealth properly is a part of faith."
